verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU. An official MCP server for agents to connect to is a software-service axis that does not fit a hardware processor, so this is a category error rather than a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip ships an MCP server; the llms.txt probe concerns Intel's corporate website, not this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
